'''Trophies''' are decorative [[:Category:Blocks|Blocks]] that are dropped from [[:Category:Derived_Parasites|Derived]] parasites.

==''Kirin Trophy''==
{{Item Info|title1=Kirin Trophy|image1=Kirin Trophy.png|type=Item|stackable=Yes (64)|tooltip=N/A|id=srparasites:trophy_void_orb}}
The Kirin Trophy is a guaranteed drop from the [[Kirin]]. It resembles its void orb attack both in item and block form.












==''Draconite Trophy''==
{{Item Info|title1=Draconite Trophy|image1=Draconite Trophy.png|type=Item|stackable=Yes (64)|tooltip=N/A|id=srparasites:trophy_boom_orb}}
The Draconite Trophy is a guaranteed drop from [[Draconite|Draconites]]. It resembles their saliva attack both in item and block form.












==''Usage''==
Aside from being decorative, both Trophies can be used to craft the [[Derived Module]].
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Kirin Trophy|r1_a2=Ancient Module|r1_b2=False Apple|r1_c2=Ancient Module|r1_b3=Draconite Trophy|r1_output=Derived Module|r1_count=1}}
